name: coral
description: Control and diagnose Coral audio enhancement from an AI assistant.
long_description:
Exposes Coral's diagnostics (fxdiag) and control surface (Coral.exe's command-line options) as MCP resources, tools, and prompts, so Claude can inspect the current audio environment and drive presets, equalizer, effects, and output device selection.

Requires Coral (https://coral.com) to already be installed -- this extension connects to your existing installation at its default install location; it does not include or install Coral itself.

Everything runs locally: this extension makes no network calls of its own and sends no data anywhere. It only launches the already-installed Coral.exe/fxdiag.exe and reads their local output.
